title: The Apple, Please
can_do: 在两个可见选项中礼貌请求自己想要的物品，并在拿错时修正。
trigger: Mom offers two snack choices, then hands over the wrong one by mistake.
core_response: Can I have the apple, please?
stretch_response: Can I have the red apple, please?
repair_response: No, I mean the apple, please.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Would you like the apple or the banana for your snack?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Can I have the apple, please?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: No, I mean the apple, please.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Oh, you asked for the apple. Here it is.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Yes, that one. Thank you, Mom!

replay_cards.title: Choose a drink
replay_cards.challenge: Mom reaches for the other drink; clarify and receive the right one

replay_cards.title: Choose a book
replay_cards.change: Ask for the bear or train book
replay_cards.challenge: Dad picks up the other book; clarify and begin the chosen story

parent_support: Offer two choices the child can see.
If you hand over the wrong one, make it a believable mistake and correct it immediately after the child clarifies.
